en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the one who dyes his head with the henna, then it becomes inevitable for him with regards to the Ablution (Wudhu). Heasws said: ‘He is not allowed until he pours in the hair of his head with the water’ (attached to his hands).
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya in a marfu‘ manner has narrated from the following: “About a man who dyes his head with henna and notices it during Wudu’, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, has said, ‘It is not permissible until water reaches the skin of his head.’”
